g.text: SOCIAL BUTTERFLIES FOUNDATION
Donor usability affinity map
Moderated usability study · 10 prior donors · 5 mobile / 5 desktop
T1 · Find apparel
8/10 independently completed
P04 missed the apparel category. P07 expected shirts
under a different category.
F03 · Category labels did not match some shoppers’
expectations
Test clearer apparel labels and navigation placement.
T2 · Personalize an item
6/10 independently completed
P02 rechecked the name field. P06 could not tell
whether a number had applied, and P09 was unsure
whether customization was confirmed.
F02 · Shoppers were unsure whether customization
saved
Confirm updates immediately and keep the chosen name or
number visible in the summary.
T3 · Find delivery information
5/10 independently completed
P01 searched the footer for a delivery estimate. P05
looked for the fulfillment policy, and P07 could not
see delivery reassurance.
F01 · Delivery information was hard to find
Show a concise production and shipping estimate on the
product page with a clear details link.
T4 · Review the order
7/10 independently completed
P04 exited before order review. P07 stopped at
checkout. P09 hesitated when the total changed.
F04 · Some shoppers struggled to reach or trust
order review
Put selections, full costs, and fulfillment details together
before payment.
What worked · P03, P08, and P10
All three completed all four tasks independently. P03 used a collection and confirmed choices in the summary.
P08 used category filters and followed the intended path. P10 checked the total and continued confidently.
